entries.rule: Visible buyer-facing copy must not discuss local pages, published pages, URLs, SEO structure, keyword targeting, pipeline stages, or implementation intent.

feedbackLedger.before: Why city details matter. A local page should answer more than do you serve my city?
feedbackLedger.after: Plan the replacement. The installation depends on your home and current equipment.
feedbackLedger.ownerDecision: reject internal SEO framing in visible copy
feedbackLedger.rationale: The customer needs installation guidance, not commentary about how a landing page should work.

regressionRules.check: flag buyer-facing references to local page, published page, URL, SEO, keyword, pipeline, or implementation unless the user is explicitly reading documentation
